# Graph expansion generation uses response element types and navigation-property metadata

The original extractor tracks navigation availability separately from representable fields. Selection excludes navigation properties; expansion variants use supported named targets, and an empty enum records unavailable targets. Bodyless request generation derives selection/expansion option types from the success body, unwraps pageable CollectionResponse targets and clears delta collection status. Exact option name and in=query metadata still gate generation. Collection outputs now use element selection enums. Current generator code is split into structs/enums and uses NamedObjectSchema; Message later gains an extended-property variant. These scoped types are not a real-path support guarantee.

Scope: Graph schema and request generator option targets.
